name: Interaction_Logs
description: Comprehensive log of all communications across WhatsApp, email, SMS, phone, and system-generated messages. Each record captures message content, delivery status, LLM processing results, and links back to the relevant work item and person.
record_count_estimate: High volume - multiple interactions per work item, expect thousands per month

fields.name: interaction_id
fields.description: Unique auto-incrementing identifier for each interaction

fields.name: work_item_id
fields.description: Link to the work item this interaction relates to, if applicable

fields.name: person_id
fields.description: Link to the person who sent or received this message

fields.name: direction
fields.description: Whether the message was received from or sent to the external party

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Communication channel used for this interaction

fields.name: message_type
fields.description: Type of message content, determining how it is processed and displayed

fields.name: message_content
fields.description: Full text content of the message, or description for non-text message types

fields.name: whatsapp_message_id
fields.description: WhatsApp Cloud API message identifier for delivery tracking and deduplication

fields.name: template_name
fields.description: Name of the WhatsApp message template used for outbound template messages

fields.name: media_url
fields.description: URL to the media file (image, document, audio, video) associated with this message

fields.name: llm_processed
fields.description: Whether this interaction has been processed by the LLM for intent extraction and data parsing

fields.name: llm_intent
fields.description: Intent classification extracted by the LLM (e.g. REPORT_ISSUE, PROVIDE_INFO, CONFIRM, ESCALATE)

fields.name: llm_confidence
fields.description: Confidence score (0.00 to 1.00) from the LLM intent classification

fields.name: delivery_status
fields.description: Delivery status of outbound messages, updated via webhook callbacks

fields.name: error_message
fields.description: Error message if delivery failed, including WhatsApp Cloud API error codes

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the interaction was logged

fields.name: scenario_execution_id
fields.description: Make.com scenario execution identifier linking this interaction to the automation run that processed it

views.name: All Interactions
views.description: Complete log of all interactions across all channels

views.name: By Work Item
views.description: Interactions grouped by work item to view the full conversation history for each job

views.name: Failed Messages
views.description: Outbound messages that failed to deliver, requiring investigation or retry

views.name: Recent
views.description: Most recent interactions across all channels, sorted by creation time
